searchText: Is there any Rust SSZ crate that does *not* depend on `alloy-primitives`? I'm trying to find a library that can be used outside of an Ethereum context. check here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/2138 Yeah those are the ones I was aware of, plus sszb. Wasn't sure if there was some others, thanks.
